title: Read-only search and status paths can mutate the SQLite FTS index
description: Evidence: runSearch and inspectSearchIndex call FtsSearchIndex.open(..., { create:false }), but open still opens SQLite writable and runs CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Impact: nominally read-only search/status commands can dirty .boreal/cache/index.sqlite, mask permission issues, or contend with real rebuilds.
acceptanceCriteria: create:false opens SQLite read-only and never initializes schema.
Tests assert sync status and search query do not modify index.sqlite when the index already exists.
closedReason: Read-only opens and queries preserve index size and mtime and never initialize or repair SQLite.
